## Purpose
GitHub Actions workflows for deploying the site and refreshing a hosted resume file. `deploy-pages.yml` builds the Vite app and publishes `./dist` to GitHub Pages; `fetch-and-commit.yml` periodically downloads a resume PDF and commits it.

## Key concepts
- `deploy-pages.yml`: runs on push to `main` and manual dispatch; Node 20, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, then `upload-pages-artifact` and `deploy-pages` in a separate `deploy` job. Concurrency group cancels in-progress runs.
- `fetch-and-commit.yml`: weekly cron (`0 0 * * 1`) plus manual dispatch; `curl`s a file into `resume.pdf` and commits if the tree changed. The download URL and file name come from secrets `FILE_URL` and `LOCAL_FILE_NAME`.
- The resume file is consumed by the UI via `resumeFileUrl` in [[src-components-avatar-card]].

## Gotchas
- `fetch-and-commit.yml` pushes to branch `origin static-data`, but checks out the default branch and never switches to `static-data`, so the push target and checked-out state may not match.
- The workflow writes to hard-coded `resume.pdf`; `LOCAL_FILE_NAME` is set in env but not used by the curl or git add commands.
- `git diff --quiet` ignores untracked files, so a newly created `resume.pdf` would not trigger the commit; only changes to an already tracked file would.
